command_set: single contiguous runs on branch catalog-api @ 6bdf991, Release configuration

performance.evidence: 20 sequential GET /api/catalog on a real host (62 products, 62 in-memory rows): min 0.6 ms, median 0.7 ms, max 4.5 ms.
performance.note: No threshold was promised by the epic; the measured cost is dominated by HTTP, not by the query.

reliability.evidence: Unknown filter -> 400 naming the allowed values; unsupported method -> 405; no match -> 200 []; 401/403/200 by permission. No unhandled exception observed in two real-host smoke runs.
reliability.note: The endpoint is read-only, so it cannot corrupt state; the catalogue is an immutable snapshot.

operability.evidence: One structured log line per answered request carrying caller, filters and count; a refused request writes no line. Security headers present on API responses.
operability.note: No health endpoint exists in the application. Pre-existing, not promised by this epic.

residual_risk: A valid bearer token was not exercised on a real host (that needs a real machine-to-machine token). A missing and a malformed token were both rejected 401 by the production JwtBearer scheme; the accepted-token path is covered in-process at the policy level.
